first_priority_anima_fit_path.fit: anima phi proxy (eeg.cond.4 1순위 FROZEN) is in-house operationalization without canonical anchoring. PyPhi (Tononi lab IIT 4.0 reference, PLOS CB 2018) provides causal-structural Phi reference; AntroPy (BSD-3, Numba JIT) provides LZ76 algorithmic-complexity primitive that anima-eeg-core currently reimplements.
first_priority_anima_fit_path.integration_path: references/pyphi/ + references/antropy/ via git clone (raw#15 additive). Wrapper hexa: anima-eeg-core/tool/phi_canonical_compare.hexa emits 3-column comparison (anima-internal vs PyPhi-Phi vs AntroPy-LZ) on existing eeg.cond.4 windows.
first_priority_anima_fit_path.license_compatibility: PyPhi GPLv3 import-only safe; any wrapper redistribution requires GPL-compatibility OR substitution with AntroPy primitives. Recommendation: redistribute only AntroPy-based parts; PyPhi stays import-only reference.
first_priority_anima_fit_path.expected_outcome: PASS (rho >= 0.6) -> anima phi proxy gains canonical anchoring; new metric `phi_canonical_agreement` registered. FAIL (rho < 0.3) -> proxy measures something else; relabel + document. Either way, scientific information yield > 0.

honest_c3_raw_10.stance: high-confidence tier (PyPhi/MNE-Python/TransformerLens/nnsight/pyvene/Captum/SAELens/Pythia/Mamba/RWKV/AntroPy) all have peer-reviewed papers + active orgs. Lower-confidence tier (EEG-to-text family) is openly contested in the literature; khu-aims/EEG-To-Text exists specifically as a noise-baseline diagnostic for prior claims. Audit ranks accordingly: top-5 are all high-confidence; EEG-to-text family demoted to 'research artifacts, not production sisters' with noise-baseline caveat.

PyPhi is GPLv3 - import-only is safe but redistribution requires GPL-compatibility. Top-1 recommendation pairs PyPhi with AntroPy (BSD-3) so license-clean fallback exists for any anima-shipped wrapper code. PCIst license is research-permissive but unclear; legal-review gate before redistribution. All other top-5 candidates are MIT/BSD-3/Apache-2.0 (anima-compatible).

Angle 4 (substrate-coupled dialogue) and Angle 7 (hexa-lang) yielded no external sisters. Honest reading: hexa-lang is anima-internal vocabulary so (a) anima first-mover - very likely. Substrate-coupled dialogue could be (a) or (b) keyword miss; field overlaps with neurofeedback/affective-BCI research where a more targeted search might surface candidates. Logged as deferred follow-up; not a top-5 promotion.

tribev2 closure was caused by asking encoder-only architecture to do chat-unblock. Each top-5 candidate is fit-anchored to a specific anima sub-system AND has a preregistrable falsifier. But only F-PHI-CANON-1 and F-MNE-1 are fully runnable in this cycle's budget. F-NNSIGHT-1 needs CLM v4 to work under nnsight (arch-agnostic claim should be smoke-tested on dummy first). F-PYTHIA-1 needs H100. Order: PyPhi+AntroPy first (lowest risk), then MNE-Python, then nnsight smoke.

tribev2 model: clone to references/<name>/ as read-only checkout, anima runtime never imports external code, hexa wrappers call externals only at user-explicit runtime. Same convention applied to all 5 top candidates. Preserves raw 'py -> hexa only' rule. Avoids 'sister becomes hard runtime dep' failure mode. Clone commands in audit doc reflect this convention.
